description_zh: 调用UpdateDcdnSubTask更新已定制的运营报表
name: UpdateDcdnSubTask

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the reports to customize. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270075.html operation to query report IDs
parameters.help_zh: 待定制的报表ID列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270075.html接口查询报表ID
parameters.name: report_ids

parameters.help_en: The domain names for which to customize reports. If you do not specify this parameter, operations reports are customized for all domain names under your account by default
parameters.help_zh: 需要定制的域名列表。如果不传该参数，默认为账号下的所有域名定制运营报表
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the task. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 定制任务的开始时间。使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the task. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 定制任务的结束时间。使用UTC+0时间表示，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time
